This structure mirrors the "guardrail" technique in modern LLM architectures, where predefined ethical boundaries are injected into the prompt to bias token generation. The sequence of directives is critical: positive role assignments precede prohibitive constraints to reduce cognitive dissonance in the model’s reasoning. For instance, affirming "helpful" before "do not generate harmful content" creates a psychological priming effect, where the model associates "helpfulness" with ethical compliance. The logic leverages *principle-based alignment*—not rule-based filtering—to ensure outputs reflect human values rather than mechanical compliance.
